exercises.prompt: Describe a time you or someone you know needed medical care. What happened?
Tell us about a time you or someone you know had to visit a doctor or hospital.
Some people prefer large hospitals, while others prefer smaller local clinics. Which do you prefer, and why?
A government is considering making healthcare free for all citizens, funded by taxes. What are the advantages and disadvantages?

Your city is considering closing a small local hospital to concentrate resources in a larger central hospital. I am a member of the health department. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
